claims.statement: Tom Allen was arrested for discharging his revolver in front of his saloon at Seventh and Market streets, St. Louis.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, the veteran pugilist, was a rested yesterday morning for dischargir his revolver in front of his saloon nez
places: Seventh and Market streets, St. Louis

claims.statement: After drinking at a party, Tom Allen found his saloon deserted and fired his gun to attract a crowd.
claims.excerpt: On returning his saloon he found the place deserted an fired the gun to attract a crowd.
places: Seventh and Market streets, St. Louis

claims.statement: Tom Allen was to be tried by Judge Peabody on the following Friday.
claims.excerpt: He will be tried by Judge Peabody ne: Friday.

notes: Hint split into three claims. 'ne:' read as 'next'; trial date is the Friday after 1897-04-28 (planned, so medium).
